vs_credit_spread: Credit spreads SELL premium (2 legs). Option buying PURCHASES single CE or PE — profits when premium rises.

families.title: Proprietary entry signals — different brains, same product
families.subtitle: Each uses a unique signal to pick CE vs PE and strike. All buy single options intraday. Exit rules vary.

members.name: Index Scalper
members.one_liner: Fast scalping on index moves. High trade count, 46% WR but huge winners (+2457 pts all-time).

members.name: SkewHunter TSL
members.one_liner: Same skew entry + trailing stop exit. More 2026 activity than base SkewHunter.

pairwise.headline: signal-based exit vs trailing stop — what changes step to step
bullets: Entry model: Index Scalper and SkewHunter TSL use different proprietary signals to pick CE vs PE — not just a parameter tweak.
Exit mechanics: Index Scalper uses signal-based exit; SkewHunter TSL uses trailing stop.
2026 net: SkewHunter TSL +824.5 pts vs Index Scalper +979.8 pts (-155.3 pts gap).
Trade WR: 37.0% vs 46.1% (-9.1 pp) — lower WR but bigger avg winners.
Activity: 24.2/mo vs 21.9/mo on Index Scalper (more signals).

families.title: Fixed stop loss — hard % cap on loss
families.subtitle: SL in name (25–40%). If premium drops X%, exit. Simpler risk, no trailing.

members.name: Savdhaan 35% SL
members.one_liner: Conservative fixed 35% SL. +1017 pts in 2026 alone. Hindi "caution" — defensive sizing.

pairwise.headline: both fixed SL — Savdhaan wider stop, Sookshma tighter 25% cap
bullets: Savdhaan = “caution” — wider 35% hard stop, strong 2026 run. Sookshma = tighter 25% SL, smaller losses but fewer home runs.
Stop width: 35% on Savdhaan 35% SL vs 25% on Sookshma-Nazar 25% SL — tighter stop on Sookshma-Nazar 25% SL.
Directional mix: Savdhaan 35% SL 88.4% CE / 11.6% PE vs Sookshma-Nazar 25% SL 40.9% CE / 59.1% PE.
2026 net: Sookshma-Nazar 25% SL +894.2 pts vs Savdhaan 35% SL +1028.6 pts (-134.4 pts gap).
Trade WR: 39.4% vs 40.6% (-1.2 pp) — lower hit rate.

families.title: Fixed risk-reward (RR 1:2 or 1:3)
families.subtitle: Targets fixed multiple of risk. Exits at target OR stop. Lower frequency, defined payoff.
